result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I would recommend **Linear** as the best overall project management tool, especially if you're building a tech product.

However, the best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and how you work. A startup of 3 people has very different needs from one with 30 employees.

Here are the tools I'd seriously consider.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Fast, clean interface.
- Great for developers and product teams.
- Integrates with GitHub and Slack.

Website: [Linear](https://linear.app)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Tasks, projects, documents, goals and dashboards.
- Highly customizable.
- Good for marketing, sales, operations and product.
- Can replace several separate tools.

Website: [ClickUp](https://clickup.com)

---

![To-Do & Calendar (Easy Drag & Drop Task) Template by Planquo | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opE1Mc-PmHvLmd55WW3_A2rdSSH5Lzq7XxcVubuuZDmh0BL2E9aDG65OpsVt7603bcP55SF0Ba_Ph8TKvVJPWk8Xtgw6FtxxZFZRfkxZq3jPTp5LZw4LO6cTnPtpXjOjH28CEd84S5UTbKhnCt1oC254QQi1TJWRpiBeni8w0hFWGa0ucRka6gv2zazVcmbB?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage startups)

- Project management and company wiki.
- Meeting notes and documentation.
- Startup strategy and business planning.
- Flexible databases and templates.

Website: [Notion](https://notion.so)

---

![Introducing Dashboards - a new way to see real-time project data in charts! - Product Launches - Asana Forum](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wCWLFp4dMEl_v-oRmbowsFC6S4_evWBQMtRxSSXp7OXP6wtqD-ndySpIhbE0vKytZ9TUoZukBYXzktu332gBeqtOvFB5r_4mn9l1GOAEawsVNLrfaNRXIZhTP4IIa9xyWd0YUcL0lL-4dUI7q2c9LjUAelrs03KqyhIOzNbo8gDFWwNUhH6KJIHf5z_4WbFK?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent cross-team coordination.
- Clear task ownership and deadlines.
- Project timelines and dependencies.
- Good for growing teams.

Website: [Asana](https://asana.com)

---

![What's New - monday.com Product Updates](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/A6uqDbwZDZtLi6fdSQ4vBgCQbnekV0PIx4KVuVyvOr829LpE2bCzHdwMLqPfPl8gWESkzkwLYt7S32LGreo4ooKI7LMbOa3LDgEJY5XamBVn4I4fKACcjxheDQNjN3kYBWjEyVTME7rTaH0lrtDPHD2D7YT1KNXf7LC0zf16zSR-GU4N3mIXikR458xkW8a1?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Highly visual project tracking.
- Great dashboards and automation.
- Useful for marketing, sales and operations.
- Easy for non-technical employees.

Website: [Monday.com](https://monday.com)

These choices reflect the different strengths identified in recent 2026 comparisons. ## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 people | Notion |
| 5–15 people | ClickUp |
| Tech/SaaS startup | Linear |
| 15–50 people | Asana |
| Marketing/operations-heavy | Monday.com |
